input.overview: On Nip-It, the center mushroom zips the flippers, the cabinet button controls the gator, and the lower-right saucer begins a repeatable lock-and-release Multiball route. Shoot the lower-right saucer to lock a ball and collect the current bonus. Hit either upper Release Ball target to start Multiball; relocking a ball collects the still-held bonus again, allowing repeated release-and-relock cashouts.
input.simpleOverview: Hit the center mushroom to zip the flippers. Shoot the lower-right saucer to lock a ball and collect bonus, then hit either upper Release Ball target to start two-ball Multiball. During Multiball, relock a ball to collect the held bonus again; release it and repeat while control lasts.
input.summary: Keep the flippers zipped whenever possible and let the ball settle across them before shooting. Build bonus before the first lock because locking does not reset it; then use repeated release-and-relock cycles for the strongest scoring route.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit either upper Release Ball target after locking.

steps.text: Hit the center mushroom to zip the flippers.
Build bonus toward 10,000, then shoot the lower-right saucer to lock a ball and collect it.
Hit either upper Release Ball target to start two-ball Multiball.
During Multiball, relock a ball to collect the held bonus again, then release and repeat while control lasts.

alternatives.title: Gator-control route
alternatives.when: Use this when the lock or Release Ball targets are rejecting dangerously.

steps.text: Keep the flippers zipped and cradle a ball on the left.
Shoot the left gate or send the ball to the top, then press the cabinet gator button to catch the gator-saucer eject.
Repeat only if the gator feed returns safely; some setups can feed the center drain.
Build bonus near its 10,000 ceiling before locking.
Lock once and release the ball to start Multiball.
Relock and release repeatedly to collect the held bonus more than once.

machineSetup: Test the center zipper mushroom, both zipper-flipper linkages, white gate rollover, cabinet gator button, gator mechanism and feed, lower-right lock saucer, both Release Ball targets, ball serve, and bonus lamps.
Confirm the machine starts with two balls installed, locked-ball stealing between players, bonus hold through locks, tilt behavior, and whether the gator and lock ejects can be controlled safely.
